import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0011 {α : Type _} (A B : Set α) : card (A \ B) = card A - card (A ∩ B) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0011 {α : Type _} (A B : Set α) : card (A \ B) = card A - card (A ∩ B) := by
  have h1 : card (A \ B) = card A - card (A ∩ B) := by
    rw [Set.card_diff, Set.card_inter, Set.card_union, Set.card_eq, Set.card_empty, Set.card_eq_zero]
    simp only [Set.empty, Set.empty_inter, Set.empty_union, Set.empty_diff, Set.card_empty, Set.card_eq_zero]
  exact h1
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0011 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0011 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0011
